name: Ethionamide

examples.title: Patients Response to Early Switch To Oral:Osteomyelitis Study
examples.why: Not enough patient enrollment and lack of staffing

examples.title: The Individualized M(X) Drug-resistant TB Treatment Strategy Study
examples.why: WHO 2022 guidelines for DR-TB treatment are set to change. These guidelines recommend the use of an all-oral short course BPAL regimen.Therefore ongoing implementation of the study is considered…

summary: Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, Ethionamide received a medium risk score of 58 for the liver and a low risk score of 22 for the heart [M]. A search found three clinical trials for the drug, with details available for two of them [3]. One trial stopped early because of a lack of staffing and low patient enrollment [4]. Another trial was affected because updated World Health Organization guidelines recommended a different treatment approach [5].
